facts.fact: The World Bank appraisal document states that the ministry in charge of communication, ICT and media (MINCOTIM) is the line ministry responsible for developing and promoting Burundi's ICT sector policy.

The World Bank-financed Digital Foundations Project (US$50 million grant) includes technical assistance for an evaluation of the ICT sector strategy (PNDTIC) and an update of its action plan; no domestic budget line is stated.

systems.owner: Government of Burundi with World Bank (IDA grant, US$50 million)
